title: The dual-cube lifting conjecture for completely independent spanning trees
statement: Let $Q_n$ be the $n$-dimensional hypercube and let $F_{n+1}$ be the dual-cube of dimension $n+1$. Let $k$ be a positive integer. **Dual-cube lifting conjecture.** If $Q_n$ has $k$ completely independent spanning trees, then $F_{n+1}$ also has $k$ completely independent spanning trees. The conjecture is motivated by the fact that each cluster of $F_n$ is isomorphic to $Q_{n-1}$ and that the cluster-connecting graph admits edge-disjoint connecting structures. The paper establishes a construction for two completely independent spanning trees, but the asserted implication for arbitrary $k$ remains open.
source_name: Mohammed Lalou, Nader Mbarek, Abdallah Skender and Olivier Togni, “Constructing two completely independent spanning trees in the dual-cube”, arXiv:2607.25917 (2026).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25917

Status: **refuted** according to the source (as of July 2026). “However, this conjecture was later disproved .”
